breakdown.description: The simulation is intended to be 2D, but the front and back patches are set to `type wall`. This incorrectly applies shear stress on these faces, making the simulation three-dimensional and yielding incorrect results for a 2D case.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly changed the frontAndBack patches from `type wall;` to `type empty;` in the boundary file, and changed the boundary conditions in U and p (and additionally k and omega) from noSlip/zeroGradient to `type empty;`, matching the ground truth for a proper 2D simulation.
